plan.goal: Extract the year from the image_date column and export the street view points to a GeoJSON file for thematic mapping by year.
plan.notes: The input vector contains an existing year column (int32) and image_date column (str, e.g., '2023-1'). Parse image_date to extract the 4-digit year or validate against the existing year field. Ensure the output retains point geometry and the extracted year attribute for downstream color-coded thematic rendering.
